firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently ate a tomato reveals the first card.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player shows the card to everyone at once. Everyone may race to name the matching hidden item; this is not an exclusive answering turn.
